objective: Verify the vitals monitoring module processes the requirement-specified primary action in the HealthCore EHR test environment.
verifies: verifies nominal completion of the requirement-specified action in the Vitals module and resulting system state update with audit log creation
protocol: Start in the HealthCore EHR test environment with the test user logged in and the Vitals module active.
Execute the primary action specified in the requirement.
Verify the system response and resulting state change.
acceptance_criteria: An audit log entry is created.
